title: DroneProvenance
description: Cryptographically verifiable provenance record (v0.3 §22, ATS-009). DROS must not accept a bare principal self-assertion ('I am trusted') as provenance.

credential_type.description: NONE is a valid enum value precisely so that 'missing provenance' can be represented explicitly and tested (T2-04).

verification_status.description: UNVERIFIABLE_OFFLINE is distinct from VALID — offline verification gaps must be surfaced, not silently treated as valid (T2-04, T2-03).
